helpers.tests/container/check-stock:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
checkout=$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/../.." && pwd)
stock_entrypoint_path=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
stock_entrypoint_hash=$(sha256sum "${stock_entrypoint_path}" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
# shellcheck source=tests/container/stock
source "${checkout}/tests/container/stock"
action=${1:-check}
case "${action}" in check|lint|test|build) ;; *) printf 'Unknown stock check: %s\n' "${action}" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
if (( $# > 1 )); then printf '%s\n' 'Stock checks do not accept extra arguments.' >&2; exit 2; fi
: "${PYTHON_IMAGE:?The Makefile declares PYTHON_IMAGE}"
stock_begin "${checkout}"
python_image=
markdown_image=
shellcheck_image=
stock_image python_image "${PYTHON_IMAGE}"
if [[ ${action} == build ]]; then
    [[ ! -L dist ]]
    mkdir -p dist
    git check-ignore --quiet dist/github-config-drift.tar.gz
    artifact=$(mktemp dist/.github-config-drift.XXXXXXXX)
    if stock_run "${python_image}" -- sh tests/container/python build > "${artifact}"; then
        mv -- "${artifact}" dist/github-config-drift.tar.gz
    else
        unlink "${artifact}"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    STOCK_NETWORK=bridge stock_run "${python_image}" -- sh tests/container/python "${action}"
fi
if [[ ${action} == check || ${action} == lint ]]; then
    : "${MARKDOWN_IMAGE:?The Makefile declares MARKDOWN_IMAGE}"
    : "${SHELLCHECK_IMAGE:?The Makefile declares SHELLCHECK_IMAGE}"
    stock_image markdown_image "${MARKDOWN_IMAGE}"
    stock_image shellcheck_image "${SHELLCHECK_IMAGE}"
    STOCK_NETWORK=bridge stock_run "${markdown_image}" -- sh tests/container/markdown
    stock_readonly "${shellcheck_image}" /bin/shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR \
        configs/container/run tests/container/stock \
        tests/container/check-stock tests/container/python tests/container/markdown
fi
stock_finish
helpers.tests/container/python:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
action=${1:?Expected check, lint, test or build}
case "$action" in check|lint|test|build) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac
if [ "$action" = check ] || [ "$action" = lint ]; then
    for script in configs/container/run tests/container/stock tests/container/check-stock; do
        bash -n "$script"
    done
    for script in tests/container/python tests/container/markdown; do
        sh -n "$script"
    done
fi
if [ "$action" != build ]; then
    python -m venv /scratch/venv >&2
    /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt >&2
fi
if [ "$action" = check ] || [ "$action" = lint ]; then
    /scratch/venv/bin/ruff check .
    /scratch/venv/bin/ruff format --check .
fi
if [ "$action" = check ] || [ "$action" = test ]; then
    /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=/scratch/pytest
fi
if [ "$action" = check ] || [ "$action" = build ]; then
    python -m py_compile check-drift.py test_check_drift.py
    if [ "$action" = build ]; then
        exec tar --create --gzip --file - check-drift.py configs
    fi
    mkdir -p dist
    tar --create --gzip --file dist/github-config-drift.tar.gz check-drift.py configs
fi

python-sweep.requirements:
pytest==9.1.1
ruff==0.17.3
# The sweep parses each repository's lint config to compare the shared part, and
# reads the ShellCheck and markdownlint steps out of a workflow.
PyYAML==6.0.3

steps.name: Run test
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
: "${GITHUB_SHA:?CI requires its expected source commit}"
ci_revision=$(git --no-optional-locks -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null rev-parse HEAD)
ci_status=$(git --no-optional-locks -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)
if [[ ${ci_revision} != "${GITHUB_SHA}" || -n ${ci_status} ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'CI requires the clean expected source commit.' >&2
  exit 125
fi
if [[ ! ${GITHUB_SHA} =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'CI requires a full expected commit SHA.' >&2
  exit 125
fi
ci_control_blob=$(git --no-optional-locks -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null rev-parse --verify "${GITHUB_SHA}:tests/container/stock")
ci_control_entry=$(git --no-optional-locks -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null ls-tree "${GITHUB_SHA}" -- tests/container/stock)
if [[ ( ${ci_control_entry} != "100644 blob ${ci_control_blob}"$'\t'"tests/container/stock" && ${ci_control_entry} != "100755 blob ${ci_control_blob}"$'\t'"tests/container/stock" ) || ! -f tests/container/stock || -L tests/container/stock || ( ${ci_control_entry} == 100644* && -x tests/container/stock ) || ( ${ci_control_entry} == 100755* && ! -x tests/container/stock ) || $(git hash-object --no-filters -- tests/container/stock) != "${ci_control_blob}" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'CI stock control source differs from the expected regular blob.' >&2
  exit 125
fi
source tests/container/stock
stock_begin "$PWD"
[[ ${revision} == "${GITHUB_SHA:?}" ]]
[[ ${source_dirty} == false ]]
stock_image python_image "__PYTHON_IMAGE__"
STOCK_NETWORK=bridge stock_run "${python_image}" -- sh -ec '
python -m venv /scratch/venv >&2
/scratch/venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt >&2
exec /scratch/venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=/scratch/pytest
'
stock_finish
